evidence: Alters src/net_processing.cpp and blockencodings to handle transaction and block deserialization rejections over P2P streams.
rationale: Protects nodes against peer-driven memory exhaustion by rejecting invalid transactions during P2P stream deserialization. A malicious peer could previously 'send a 4 MB block containing roughly 400,000 empty transactions (10 bytes each) that each allocate a full CTransaction object'.
